summary: testHiddenHoverControlsDoNotBlockSidebarRowSelection uses a deterministic fixture that ties both opacity(0) and allowsHitTesting to the same visibility flag under real hover; since SwiftUI opacity(0) does not disable hit-testing by default, removing the allowsHitTesting binding would make the archive/newChat/diff buttons hittable and hijack the click, which the chatTitle-equality and isHittable(false) assertions would genuinely catch.
